column1: # piece: Anton Bruckner, Symphony No. 8 in C minor, II. Scherzo, Allegro moderato, bars 1-61 (+ bar 62 for context)

# edition: Eulenburg kleine Orchester-Partitur-Ausgabe, Symphonien No. 66 (IMSLP #30702), <work>/dl/scores/br8.pdf. No editor named (no Haas / Nowak); an early Eulenburg miniature, presumably the 1892 first-edition text (inference, not printed). Instruments: 3 Fl, 3 Ob, 3 Kl, 3 Fg (Kontrafagott listed with Fg. III in mvt I; not marked here), 8 Hörner (I-VI in F, VII VIII in tief B), 3 Tr in F, Alt-/Tenor-Posaune (Pos. I II) + "Pos. u. Kb. Tb." staff (Pos. III and Kontrabaßtuba), Pauken, strings. No harp in bars 1-62. Horns V-VIII play horn here (no Wagner tubas in this passage).
# page 53 (printed 54): bars 5-9 (top system), 10-15 (bottom system; A = bar 11)
# time signature: 3/4 throughout; beat unit = quarter; bars counted from the Scherzo's first bar (no pickup)

# doubts: parts that share a staff get the staff's marking; "zu 2"/"zu 3"/"I"/"III" labels decide who plays, a chord means both players. Vl. I is on two staves bars 15/16-30 (vl1a upper, vl1b lower); elsewhere its divisi chords are on one staff and stay vl1. Trombone III vs. Kb. tuba on the shared bottom staff bars 36-40 is unclear (both given). Notes spans run to the last note before a rest of a whole bar or more; staccato dots and slurs not transcribed. Readings marked "uncertain" in the comment.
